about: The Workbench icons of the HolotzCastle drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is upstream's res/icon/icon.bmp (32x32) at 48x48. HolotzCastle-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, HolotzCastle.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's HolotzCastle.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for the licence; Folder.info for res and the drawers in it.
